criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close, delete, terminate, or cancel an account.

categories.name: Account Eligibility
categories.definition: Questions about requirements to open or use an account, including age or location restrictions.

categories.name: Account Login Issues
categories.definition: Problems accessing the app or account, including password reset or phone theft.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems with ATM withdrawals, including cash not received, card retained, ATM fees, or pending ATM transactions.

categories.name: Card Activation
categories.definition: Requests to activate a new or replacement card.

categories.name: Card Block or Freeze
categories.definition: Requests to block, freeze, unblock, or reactivate a card.

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Questions about card shipping, delivery status, ordering new or replacement cards, or card expiration renewal.

categories.name: Card Damage
categories.definition: Reports of physically damaged cards needing replacement.

categories.name: Card Decline
categories.definition: Issues where card payments are being declined at POS, online, or ATM.

categories.name: Card Linking
categories.definition: Questions about linking or adding a card to the app.

categories.name: Card Loss or Theft
categories.definition: Reports of lost, stolen, or missing cards.

categories.name: Card Acceptance
categories.definition: Questions about where cards are accepted, card types available, or what cards can be used for.

categories.name: Contactless Payment Issues
categories.definition: Problems with contactless payments not working.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about exchange rates, currency options, or exchange fees.

categories.name: Fee Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about fees charged or fee structures.

categories.name: Fraud or Unauthorized Transaction
categories.definition: Reports of suspicious, unrecognized, or unauthorized transactions.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about identity verification requirements or process.

categories.name: Personal Details Update
categories.definition: Requests to update personal information like address or name.

categories.name: PIN Issues
categories.definition: Problems with PIN, including reset, change, or unblock requests.

categories.name: Refund Issues
categories.definition: Questions about refund process or missing refunds from merchants.

categories.name: Top-up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with adding money to account, including failed, pending, or reverted top-ups.

categories.name: Transaction Cancellation
categories.definition: Requests to cancel or reverse a transfer or payment.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending or receiving money transfers.

categories.name: Virtual or Disposable Card
categories.definition: Questions about virtual or disposable card features and limits.
